tolerance_reason: Deterministic runs compare all integer outputs exactly. Nondeterministic runs compare immutable storage and scratch exactly and require safe final color/flag agreement, conflict-free solver colors, valid convergence state, and a surviving winner in every nonempty conflict component. Sparse fixtures must converge within their budget; dense exhausted graphs may route unresolved contacts to bucket zero.
preconditions: Complete cumulative adjacency with explicit static-group metadata; valid active link bodies/groups, zero-length gaps premarked inert for Topo steps
Topo inputs are colors 0 through 63; pending values are valid colors or MAX; exhausted masks publish zero, never 64
Reset grids cover all slots; scalar flags use one thread; finite bounded u32 counters and no overflowing addresses
invariants: Luby priorities use modulo-2^32 hashing and current-round winners still block lower-priority neighbors
Split hub velocity slots remove their conflicts in Topo; Luby preserves its original graph traversal
Deterministic picks only update pending values; conflict pruning preserves the highest-index winner
Nondeterministic choices must be first-free for a legal observation of each neighbor, not merely an arbitrary valid color
Input fields, fixed colors, sentinel slots and unused dispatch triples are preserved exactly
All phases execute generated kernels over persistent buffers without host physics arithmetic or intermediate readback
Zero indirect grid suppresses step/fix bodies; finalization always runs after all readers
Dense graphs exceeding the 63-color palette retain unresolved contacts as color zero for unsolved solver handling
